title: Pattern verification and stock simulation: check stock bounds, fixture hits, machine travel, and simulate all copies

body:
## Goal

Extend the post verification gate and stock simulation to judge every enabled copy of a pattern folder, so any unsafe copy blocks the post by name and copy index (AGENTS.md "Never Crash, Never Gouge"). Depends on the pattern folder sub-issue of `#2938`.

## Scope

- **Stock simulation (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`):** Expand all enabled pattern copies in exact posting order (`ByTool` or `ByPart`) inside `plan_program`. Carve every enabled copy into the setup stock dexel grid so the user sees all copies and `deviate` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/deviate.rs`) blocks on any gouge into the model.
- **Fixture collision (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `crates/app/src/fixture_struck.rs`):** Run `op_hits` on every enabled copy's transformed `Toolpath` and every inter-copy clearance rapid link against turning fixtures, fixed fixtures, closed fixture meshes, and the machine table. Report hits with folder name, operation name, copy index, move index, and struck fixture.
- **Machine limits (`crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs`):** Check every enabled copy's transformed moves in `check_ops` against stated X/Y/Z travel strokes and feed ceilings.
- **Stock bounds check:** Verify that every enabled pattern copy stays inside the setup's stock XY bounds (within `0.01 mm` for the transformed cut region) and intersects stock. Block the post by folder name and copy index if a copy leaves the stock.
- **Disabled copies:** Skip copies listed in `disabled_instances` across all checks and simulation, so disabling a copy over a clamp clears its collision finding.

## Done means

Tests prove that a pattern copy hitting a fixture clamp, leaving the setup stock bounds, exceeding machine travel, or gouging the model blocks the post with the folder name and copy index; disabling that copy lets the post succeed; and `simulate_document` carves every enabled copy into the stock grid.

Part of #2938
